issues.title: Embedded signup
issues.body:
## What

Connect a WhatsApp number through Meta's official signup inside the app, with no agency or paperwork in between.

**Module:** Onboarding and WhatsApp setup · **Phase:** Launch · **Priority:** P0

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Seller completes Meta Embedded Signup from the onboarding screen without leaving the app
- [ ] WABA ID, phone number ID and access token are stored encrypted per workspace
- [ ] Webhook subscription is registered automatically and verified with a test message
- [ ] Failure states (rejected, cancelled, number already registered) show a clear Arabic/English explanation

## Tasks

- [ ] **API** (`apps/api/modules`): domain model and migrations, endpoints + form requests + resources, authorization policy, events in `packages/contracts`, Pest unit and feature tests, workspace isolation test
- [ ] **Web** (`apps/web/layers/onboarding`): screens and components, Arabic + English strings, RTL check, loading / empty / error states, real-time updates where relevant, Vitest tests

## Definition of done

- [ ] Works in Arabic (RTL) and English
- [ ] Workspace (tenant) isolation covered by a test
- [ ] Logs, metrics and traces for background work
- [ ] Behind a feature flag until released
- [ ] Docs / module README updated

issues.title: Choose the MVP WhatsApp provider (BSP) and sign the partner agreement
issues.body:
## What

Until Trik is an approved Meta Tech Provider, sellers connect their numbers through a Business Solution Provider's partner programme. Pick one and sign up.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Partner API lets Trik onboard *client* numbers (integrated/embedded onboarding), not only our own
- [ ] Supports coexistence with the WhatsApp Business app
- [ ] Meta fees billed at Meta's rate, ideally paid by the seller directly (ADR 0003)
- [ ] Per-number fee fits the Starter plan margin
- [ ] Written exit path: numbers and approved templates can migrate to Trik's own Tech Provider later

## Tasks

- [ ] Compare 360dialog Partner, Gupshup, Twilio, Infobip (and any local BSP) on the criteria below
- [ ] Confirm Egypt/KSA support and payment terms
- [ ] Sign partner agreement, get sandbox
- [ ] Record the decision as ADR 0009
